parts.title: Part 1: find the differences
parts.how: Listen to the examiner. Tap the four things in picture B that are different. Then say a sentence for each one.

diffs.say: In picture A it's sunny, but in picture B it's raining.
In picture A the boy has got a balloon, but in picture B he has got a ball.
In picture A there's a bus, but in picture B there's a bike.
In picture A there are two trees, but in picture B there is one tree.

intro: Hello. Here are two pictures. They are the same, but some things are different.
exampleLines: For example, in picture A there are two cats, but in picture B there are three cats.

lines: F
Now you tell me four differences. Look at the weather, the boy, the street and the trees.

parts.title: Part 2: tell the story
parts.how: Listen to the examiner and look at the four pictures. Tell the story out loud, one picture at a time.

panels.model: Tom is playing football in the park with his friends.
Tom falls over. He hurts his leg and he's crying.
Tom's dad takes him to the hospital in the car.
The doctor puts a plaster on his leg. Now Tom is happy and he's eating an ice cream.

intro: These pictures tell a story. It's called Tom's bad day. Just look at the pictures first.
exampleLines: Tom is playing football in the park with his friends. Now you tell the story.

lines: F
Look at picture two. What happens now?
F
And in picture three? Where is Tom going?
F
And in the last picture? How does Tom feel now?

parts.title: Part 3: odd one out
parts.how: Listen. Tap the picture that is different, then say why.

example.why: The carrot is a vegetable. The others are fruit.

sets.why: The house is a building. The others are things you can ride or drive.
The dog is an animal. The others are people with jobs.
The tree is a plant. The others are buildings in a town.
The ball is a toy. The others are clothes.

intro: Now look at these pictures. One is different. The carrot is different.
exampleLines: Why? Because the carrot is a vegetable, and the others are fruit.

lines: F
Look at these four pictures. Which one is different? Why?
F
Now look at these. Which one is different? Why?
F
And these. Which one is different? Why?
F
And the last ones. Which one is different? Why?

parts.title: Part 4: questions about you
parts.how: Listen to each question and answer out loud with a full sentence. Then look at an example answer.

questions.model: My favourite place is the park, because I play with my friends there.
lines: F
What's your favourite place in your town?

questions.model: I go to school by car. My mum takes me.
lines: F
How do you go to school?

questions.model: When I'm ill, I stay in bed and I drink lots of water.
lines: F
What do you do when you are ill?

questions.model: At the weekend I play with my cousins. We ride our bikes.
lines: F
Who do you play with at the weekend?

questions.model: Last Sunday I went to the lake with my family.
lines: F
What did you do last Sunday?
